comments.body:
Thanks for fixing these stale defaults and explaining the model choices. There is one remaining issue with the connection test that I'd like to get fixed as well.

`build_anthropic_test_payload()` leaves out `max_tokens`. Both `/api/ai/providers/test` and `/api/ai/providers/anthropic/test` use that helper, so switching to `claude-sonnet-4-6` still leaves the test request missing a required field for the [Anthropic Messages API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/create). This issue already exists on the base branch, but it means the connection-test fix described here is still incomplete.

Could you add an explicit `max_tokens` value for the connection probes and cover the outgoing request in a regression test? Please also update `test_anthropic_test_payload_does_not_set_output_token_limit`, which currently asserts that this required field is absent. A small token limit is enough for the short probe response. Thanks again!

Thanks, done in cca2bb2. `build_anthropic_test_payload()` now sets `max_tokens` (64, enough for the short probe reply), so both `/api/ai/providers/test` and `/api/ai/providers/anthropic/test` send it. A new test calls both endpoints with the HTTP session stubbed and checks the outgoing Messages request includes the model and `max_tokens`, and `test_anthropic_test_payload_does_not_set_output_token_limit` is now `test_anthropic_test_payload_sets_required_max_tokens`.
